## Past Achievements

### Ontology
- June 2021: First public release of the [I-ADOPT ontology 0.0.8](https://i-adopt.github.io/ontology/archive/0.8.0/index.html)
- July 2023: Improved version [I-ADOPT ontology 1.0.1](https://i-adopt.github.io/ontology/archive/1.0.1/index.html)
- May 2025: Major revision [I-ADOPT ontology 1.1.0](https://i-adopt.github.io/ontology/archive/1.1.0/index.html)

## I-ADOPT Recommendations
- 2022: RDA Endorsment of the I-ADOPT Recommendations ([DOI: 10.15497/RDA00071](https://zenodo.org/records/6520132#.YnOhMJNBybQ))
